model_annotations.English: Figure 6 presents a line plot comparing the effects of different gating configurations on the activation and attention mechanisms in a neural network model. The x-axis represents time, ranging from 0 to 30 seconds, with a tick label interval of 5 seconds. The y-axis measures the level of activation and attention, with values ranging from 0 to 400. The plot includes multiple lines, each representing a different configuration. The first line, which is the baseline, shows significant activation and attention peaks, particularly after the 6th row (SDP Gating). The second line, representing Row 2 (SDP Gating), shows a similar pattern but with a lower peak. The third line, for Row 3 (Value Layer Gating), displays similar activations to Row 2. The fourth line, Row 4-5 (Reduced Sparsity via cross-head share and NS-sigmoid), shows a decrease in activations and attention, with residual attention sinking. The fifth line, Row 3 (Reduced activations and no attention sinks observed), shows no significant activations or attention. The sixth line, Row 2 (Massive activations and attention sinks resemble the baseline), shows a pattern similar to the baseline but with a more pronounced peak. The plot illustrates the varying effects of different gating configurations on the neural network's performance over time.
